$comment: The skip floor: the ONLY tests allowed to report a skipped/pending/todo status in a jest run where JEST_ENFORCE_SKIP_FLOOR is set (the canonical CI gate exports it). Enforced at run time by scripts/jest-skip-floor-reporter.cjs and reconciled against the test corpus in both directions by src/tests/unit/jestSkipFloor.test.js — a new skip marker without an entry here fails, and a stale entry whose test no longer exists also fails. Adding an entry is an auditable decision: include the file, the exact test (or describe) title, and a reason. HIGH-3 follow-up (PR #874): the lab-ORU deep suites silently skipped as green in every merge-gate lane for their whole life; this floor is the corpus-wide guard that no test can silently join them again.
